releases.title: Security review, backup test restores, What's new, server dashboard, faster voice

items.text: A monthly test restore that proves backups work.
What's new after each update. The first time you open Sara after an update, a short page lists what changed in each release since the version you last saw.

releases.title: Talk with Sara, shared projects, marketplace, picture studio, business pack

items.text: A Business place in the sidebar that brings clients, time, invoices and quotes together.
Picture editing and short video on your own computer with ComfyUI.
Shared projects between linked friends. On a project page, Shared with friends invites one or more friends whose Sara is linked under Messages, as Can view or Can edit.
Shared by friends, a community marketplace. In a Messages community or with a linked friend, share skills, templates, automations.
Talk with Sara. One button next to the message box starts a hands-free conversation in the browser, the desktop apps and the phone web app: she listens all the time.

releases.title: Settings and the new windows open again

items.text: In 3.22.0, Settings, Health, Family and every window after Money opened empty.

releases.title: Money, family planner, health log, study cards, browser extension

items.text: Sara in your browser. An extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox that pairs with your own Sara by a short code.
A Money place in the sidebar (tracking only: Sara never logs in to a bank, pays, transfers or cancels anything; the page says so).
A home and family planner in Family. Meals is a week of dinners: pick a saved family recipe or type one.
Chores can take turns. A chore moves to the next person once a week, and each person with chores left gets one reminder a day, never during their quiet hours.
Health, a private health log of your own. Medicines with dose reminders, Taken/Skipped and a refill estimate; appointments with questions to ask.
A learning coach. From any Library document, one of its chapters or text you paste, Sara makes a study set: flashcards, fill-in-the-blank cards.

releases.title: smarter: six languages, voices apart, Word comments, team recipes

items.text: Promises, clause checklists and travel emails in Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian, not just English.
Free flight status without a key. The Trips page can use OpenSky Network (no sign-up), which shows whether your plane is in the air, on the ground or landed.
Tracked changes everywhere in a Word file. When she revises a Word document, changes in the header, footer, footnotes, endnotes and text boxes are tracked too.
Team recipes. After a team run finishes, "Save as a team recipe" keeps its plan.
Ask about anything also searches your meetings (what was said, with the time in the recording, and the notes), trips.
Share fixes that worked. Under Settings → Privacy & system → Health → Self-repair you can let a fix that worked.

releases.title: the apps catch up: Dock and taskbar counts, Mac meeting recording, Android notices

items.text: "Connect the Sara phone app" no longer tells an iPhone to get the Android app from Google Play.
Errands waiting on you now count in the number on Sara's icon, in each notification's badge and in the Shortcuts widget's "Waiting for you" line.
On the screens added since 3.15 every button, field and "?" is at least 44 px to tap.

releases.title: proven on real models, Try these, steadier releases

items.text: Live checks you can run yourself. A throwaway Sara goes through every mail and calendar kind.
A Windows install and update matrix you can run on a PC: fresh install, the app updating itself, reinstall, downgrade, a manual Setup run.
Try these, a guided checklist for the owner. Help → Try these lists about 30 short checks of what is new since 3.15 (newest release first), each with a few steps.
On Teams, Matrix, Signal and iMessage the live progress message could keep its stop button (or miss a step) when the chat app was slow to post it.
Code mode scripts no longer lose script time while their sandbox process is starting, so short scripts aren't stopped as "too long" on a busy computer.
"Put my stock alerts in the Stock Alerts project" could send the alerts to the chat you asked in instead of making the project.

releases.title: several Google accounts from either mail page, approved code fixes on servers

items.text: Asking her "add another email account" or "connect my other Gmail" shows a card with your accounts and a + Add an account button that opens the choices.
Code changes on Linux servers. On a server install (install.sh), Sara can now fix her own code too, still only after you press Approve.
Adding several Google accounts works from every page and never replaces one.
